info.text:
HOA homes sell for about 4% more. Is it worth the fee?
A 2019 study found HOA homes priced at least 4% (about $13,500) above similar homes outside one.
In 2024, about 1 in 4 US owners paid a condo or HOA fee; the median was $135 a month.
Our math: $300 a month for 10 years is $36,000, and lenders count dues in your debt-to-income ratio.
In most states an HOA can foreclose over unpaid dues. Rules vary by state.
Sources: Journal of Urban Economics (2019), US Census Bureau ACS 2024, Foundation for Community Association Research.
News and education, not financial advice.
